tool_args.rationale: The narrow pilot supports smooth saturation but cannot separate candidate laws with sink dependence or determine the open branch contribution. The lower-cost open-branch discriminating probe targets that ambiguity; the short horizon is not itself a reason for a slow-horizon probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static saturation law now (e.g. Michaelis-Menten or the siphon family)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations vary only u_now; s_grad is effectively fixed, so sink inhibition and additive branch contributions remain unidentifiable.
The observed monotone concave response does not indicate memory dynamics; the higher-cost trajectory batch is not justified yet.
This is explicitly irrelevant to the candidate mechanisms and should not be purchased.
